technical-summary: Added an opt-in HI25 offline schema gate for custom MMQ/MMVQ candidates. Explicit custom kernels now require a canonical architecture mask, stable identity binding, distinct correctness reference, architecture-matched resource report digest, and passed benchmark evidence before catalog validation can proceed. Added focused regressions and documented the bounded slice.
user-summary-candidate: Added fail-closed offline readiness validation for future HI25 custom MMQ/MMVQ kernels, with focused tests and plan documentation; no speculative GPU kernel code was introduced.
